source = '''def transform(grid):
    """Keep the panel before the uniform divider; mark its 2-cells."""
    height, width = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    split_row = next((r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if 0 < r < height - 1 and len(set(row)) == 1), None)
    split_col = next((c for c in range(1, width - 1) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(height)}) == 1), None)
    if split_row is not None:
        panel = grid[:split_row]
    elif split_col is not None:
        panel = [row[:split_col] for row in grid]
    else:
        raise ValueError("No internal uniform divider found")
    return [[3 if value == 2 else 2 for value in row] for row in panel]
'''
path.write_text(source)
print(path)
